headline: Red readiness day — HRV and sleep debt say protect today, and this morning's Un1t class already spent some of that budget.
body_state: Composite readiness 38.1 (low), driver sleep: HRV last night 37ms sits below your normal band, and 14-day sleep debt is at 25h (last night only 6.1h, sleep score 72). Body Battery is 38 this morning after a modest 37-point overnight recharge. Garmin still calls training status "Productive," but the deterministic verdict is explicit — postpone quality, easy running only — and overtraining sits at "caution." TSB -14.15 / CTL 38.45: the load itself is fine, it's recovery that's short today.
session: This morning's Un1t (07:03-07:45, avg HR 135, RPE 7) is already banked — 23.2 min in Z4 and 3.5 in Z5, real anaerobic stimulus (TE 2.6) on a morning the call was easy-only. It's done, nothing to undo, but don't add to it: no more structured effort today. Nothing else is scheduled — the next session is tomorrow's 13km Long Run, already unstructured easy-pace (4:50-5:19/km, no race-pace insertions), which is the right shape for this state. Check readiness again at wake-up before committing to the full 13.4km; trim it if HRV/Battery haven't recovered.
recent: Aug 12's tempo was cut to 78% (2.98 of 4km) with HR topping out 20bpm under threshold despite RPE 8 — fatigue, not fitness. Aug 13's Un1t undershot to 41 min but stayed sensibly zone-2/3. Aug 14's "easy" run negative-split into RPE 6, closing at HR 166 — pace drifted from stride length, not cadence, which sat at 159spm the whole way. Four sessions running, the pattern is the same: intensity keeps creeping into days meant to be easy (19.7% truly easy vs an 80% target), and cadence hasn't moved off 154-161spm despite the 168-172 target set Aug 10.
focus: Nothing hard for the rest of today — this morning's Un1t already delivered the day's stimulus on a red-readiness morning.
Cadence: 168-172spm when picking up pace — Aug 12 and Aug 14 both show speed coming from longer stride, not faster turnover.
Readiness-gate tomorrow's 13km Long Run at wake-up: it's already easy-pace only, but trim the distance if HRV/Battery haven't rebounded.
